title: Liver Disease in Adults With Alpha-1 AT Deficiency
brief_summary: This cohort study will evaluate the prevalence of the infra clinical liver injuries among a group of adult patients presenting with Alpha-1 AT deficiency followed up in a large university hospital in Lyon, France.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients over 18 years old
* Presenting an Alpha-1 AT deficiency (Alpha-1 AT level \<0.8g/l at the time of diagnosis)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients presenting a liver disease not related to the Alpha-1 AT deficiency
